rationale: The provided record does not show the agent authenticating the user, nor confirming any order-changing actions before executing them as required by policy. The tool actions listed suggest address modifications were (or would be) performed on both orders, even though the user only intended to change the order that was going to the old address. There’s also no clear confirmation step prior to changing either the order address or the default user address. For the tablet exchange, there is no evidence the agent verified the item, determined the cheapest tablet via supported tools, or confirmed the exchange details before proceeding. Overall, key policy requirements—authentication, confirmation before writes, and accurate, supported actions—are not demonstrated, so the request was not completed in line with policy.
